```{r}

basket <- tq_index("S&P500")
```

```{r}
head(basket)
write.csv(basket, "sp500_basket.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#clean the dataframe
df <- read_csv("sp500_basket.csv")
head(df)

colSums(is.na(df)) #check for NA
colSums(df == "" | df == " " | df == "-") #we know sector has missing values, but not NA. check for dash/ empty space

#convert non-NA missing values to NA
df_EmptyStr_to_NA <- df |> 
    mutate(sector = na_if(sector, ""),
        sector = na_if(sector, "-")) |>
    filter(!is.na(sector)) |> 
head(df_EmptyStr_to_NA)
```
